motto: Open to few, and to them completely.
detail: You would rather be all of yourself to a handful of people than a little of yourself to everyone. The cost is that when that handful are busy, there is nobody left.

motto: My yes is yes and my no is no.
detail: Because you manage nobody, your word is worth something. The cost is that people who expected to be managed do not come back.

motto: Not solitude. Selection.
detail: Keeping your distance is a choice, not a lack — but it needs checking now and then that it is still a choice. The cost is that the day you forget to check, the choice has become a habit.

motto: I do it for myself, even if nobody sees.
detail: Your motivation does not come from outside, so it does not break from outside either. The cost is that when you are stuck, nobody notices.

motto: Deciding is a weight too. I carry it.
detail: When nobody decides, you decide, and you are usually right. The cost is that nobody sees the weight of what you carry — the small decisions included.
reminder: Today's decision is a small one. It is still yours.

motto: This time I am not convincing anyone.
detail: You move without waiting for everyone, and you are usually proved right. Today's work concerns nobody else; the only person to convince is you.
reminder: This one is only your business.

motto: Let it move at its own pace.
detail: You have a reflex to speed up whatever is going slowly. Some things move with time rather than with intervention — and waiting is the hardest part for you.

motto: Pointing the way is tiring too.
detail: Nobody asked you to, and you do it anyway. What tires you is not the work; it is that whose work it is never gets discussed.

motto: Objecting is easy. Staying is not.
detail: Objecting costs you nothing; the real thing is putting something in the place of what you objected to and keeping it there. The cost is admitting that being right is not enough.

motto: I promised myself, not anyone else.
detail: Somebody else's system does not take with you; one you build yourself might. The cost is that when it does not take, there is nobody to blame.

motto: I do not fall in line. I do not run.
detail: Disagreeing is a stance; disappearing is not. The cost is that staying and arguing is far more tiring than leaving.

motto: My raw self is more honest than my polished one.
detail: Because you do not polish, people know where they stand with you. The cost is that where polish opens doors, yours stay shut.
reminder: As you are — but do it today.

motto: Not staying down. Diving and surfacing.
detail: Once you are into a subject you go all the way to the bottom, and staying there is easy too. What is worth something is not the depth but coming back up with something.

motto: It can be done without understanding it.
detail: Doing something you do not understand goes against the grain for you. But some things are understood by doing them, not before.

motto: There is no day I will be ready.
detail: You like to start when you feel ready. That feeling does not come; the ones who feel it are the ones who already started.

motto: Things happen on the surface too.
detail: You see what is going on deep down and miss what is on top. Most of what you miss is sitting right there.

motto: With what I have today.
detail: You do not wait to be prepared, you start with what is to hand, and most people cannot do that. The cost is that because what is to hand never changes, neither does the result.

motto: Changing one small thing is change too.
detail: Big plans do not work on you; a single detail does. The cost is that a single detail takes weeks to show a result.

motto: I learn by doing, not by reading.
detail: What you are told does not take; what you do does. The cost is that you cannot learn a mistake without making it once.

motto: I can try it without being curious.
detail: New things do not pull at you, and they do not need to — trying does not require curiosity. The cost is that the first try feels strange.

motto: Not perfect. Finished.
detail: Most of what you left half-done was left by your standard, not by laziness. A standard is a good thing; applying the same one everywhere is not.

motto: This will do for now.
detail: "That is not good enough" stops the work; "this will do for now" moves it. Both are temporary, and one of them leaves progress behind.

motto: I see the difference. Today I will not look.
detail: Seeing the difference nobody else sees is a talent and a weight. Putting the weight down for a day is not losing the talent.

motto: One notch down still does the job.
detail: Doing the best takes time, and that time is stolen from something else. Choosing what has to be best is a craft of its own.

motto: Pour off a mouthful, then carry it.
detail: Everything in your hands looks urgent at once, and that is not a problem of attention but of fullness. The cost: until you pour some off, none of it gets its turn.
reminder: Put one of them down today.

motto: Feeling it does not mean I cannot do it.
detail: Feeling something intensely usually comes out as putting it off. The link is not compulsory; it can be done while you are feeling it.
reminder: Start as you are right now.

motto: Make it small. Make it finished.
detail: Big plans settle you, and then the same plans come down on top of you. One small finished thing carries you further than one large planned one.

motto: Getting through today is enough.
detail: Thinking ahead does not produce readiness in you, it produces tiredness. Staying inside today is not shrinking; it is how you keep carrying.

motto: Check the settled thing as well.
detail: Not breaking what works is your soundest quality. The cost: you take what is already broken for settled too, because it has been there so long.

motto: I chose the tried way, knowing I did not try the other.
detail: The road you know does not mislead you. Still, remembering that it was a choice turns it from a habit back into a decision.
reminder: Is this a choice or a habit?

motto: Once, the other way.
detail: Change feels like an expense to you, and most of the time you are right. But a small deviation is cheap where you have nothing to lose.

motto: My steadiness is nobody's burden.
detail: The people around you can plan by you, and you know it. Only this: always standing in the same place also means nobody asks you anything new.
reminder: What would you like to be asked today?

motto: I can say it too.
detail: Reading someone else's state is automatic for you. Saying your own is not — and until you say it, nobody asks.

motto: I noticed. Now I am saying it.
detail: Noticing is half of helping; the other half is saying so. Skip the second and you carry the weight alone.
reminder: Say the thing you noticed today.

motto: Closeness runs both ways.
detail: You think asking for the attention you give back would be forcing it. What does not come unless it is asked for is not called forcing; it is called closeness.
reminder: Ask one person for something today.

motto: Kept inside, it grows.
detail: What goes unsaid does not shrink in you, it accumulates. Saying it does not solve it, but it stops it growing.

motto: You can travel light — but not from this.
detail: Being able to put a weight down is your easiest quality. The cost: you put down the thing that should not be put down just as easily, and notice months later.
reminder: Pick the thing you will not put down today.

motto: My calm is not an answer.
detail: Your not panicking settles the people around you. But sometimes what people need is not settling — it is seeing that they were taken seriously.

motto: Not small because it came easily.
detail: You shrink what you did without effort in your own eyes. What a thing is worth is not measured by what it cost you.

motto: Let me pass the same way again today.
detail: Because you pass easily everywhere, you leave a mark nowhere. Coming back to the same place a second time is not repetition for you — it is accumulation.
reminder: Wherever you went yesterday, go today.

motto: Being alert is a strength; so is resting.
detail: Seeing it coming has paid off many times, so you do not let go of it. But a watch is not kept every night, and nobody tells you that.

motto: The whole list is not today's work.
detail: You have already thought of everything that could go wrong. Trying to solve all of it today comes out the same as solving none of it.

motto: One day is forgiven.
detail: It is not the day you missed that wears you out, it is the story you build afterwards. The chain forgives one day — you usually do not.

motto: Preparing is work too, and it ends.
detail: Preparing never ends for you, because there is always one more possibility. Stopping somewhere is not being unprepared.

motto: On my own clock, but every day.
detail: You do not have to change your hour; you do have to make it every day. The cost is agreeing to do a small thing on the days the inspiration does not come.
reminder: On your own clock today as well.

motto: When the wave passes, I am still on the shore.
detail: A lot on the good days, a little on the bad — but something on both. The cost is learning not to count the little day as a failure.

motto: Not a system. Today.
detail: A structure built for you does not help; the only thing that helps is today itself. The cost is that nobody can predict your tomorrow — you included.

motto: I am only learning to accumulate.
detail: Nothing has accumulated so far, and that is not a flaw, it is a missing habit. The cost is that the first two weeks are dull.

motto: Never in a hurry, never stopped.
detail: Going faster gains you nothing; stopping loses you everything. The cost is that for a long time nobody notices you are moving — sometimes not even you.

motto: I know where the first stone went.
detail: Everyone sees the wall; you are the one who knows where it started. Knowing that ought to be enough; most of the time it is not, and that is tiring.

motto: As much as I can show is enough.
detail: Showing something unfinished feels wrong to you. But if you never show it, the credit never reaches you either — there is a place between the two.
reminder: Let this much be seen today.

motto: Quiet is not slow.
detail: Working without a sound gets taken for working little. Knowing better serves you; sometimes saying so to somebody else is needed too.

motto: Just one of them today.
detail: Your ideas are not bad, there are too many. Choosing is hard because it is giving up rather than sorting — and until you give some up, none of them moves.

motto: Catching light is easy. Carrying is the skill.
detail: You are good at beginnings and you know it. The real thing is the part left after the excitement, and it works precisely because it is dull.
reminder: The excitement is over. The work is still here.

motto: Write it down and let it go.
detail: You cannot stop new ideas arriving; you can put off chasing them. An idea written down does not run away; an idea chased eats today.

motto: Which day, not how many ideas.
detail: Your measure has always been how much you produced. This time the measure is how many times you came back to the same thing — less exciting, and far more use.
reminder: Come back to the same thing once more.

motto: Calm, not indifferent.
detail: Your not getting flustered gets taken for not caring. That same calm also takes the discomfort out of putting things off — and that is the part to watch.
reminder: Stay calm, but do it today.

motto: Your calm has a cost.
detail: The people around you draw on your calm. What it costs you is usually known only to you, and you do not say.
reminder: Look in on yourself today too.

motto: Let me put myself out a little.
detail: You manage to live without putting anyone out. Change happens exactly where the discomfort is.

motto: Still, and still standing.
detail: Looking motionless from outside gets confused with having stopped. You are the only one who knows the difference; keep it on the right side today.

motto: Ask me too, before you ask them.
detail: While you arrange for everyone to feel good, your turn never comes. That is not sacrifice, it is habit — and habits can change.

motto: A promise to myself is a promise.
detail: You keep the promises you make to others. Breaking the ones you make to yourself feels free because you never have to apologise for it; it is not.

motto: Whoever sets the table sits at it too.
detail: Bringing people together became your job. Keeping a seat for yourself does not mean giving that job up.

motto: I do not have to tell anyone about this.
detail: Most of what you do has an audience. This does not, and having none does not make it worth less — only quiet.
reminder: It counts even if nobody sees.

motto: Saying it was easy. Staying is not.
detail: Putting the right sentence together is not courage for you, it is a reflex. The real work starts after it, and the cost is this: if you say it and leave, being right is no use to anyone.
reminder: Stay beside what you said today.

motto: If I upset the table, I set it right.
detail: You can see what you broke too; you just think it was worth breaking. Both can be true at once — count the clearing up as part of the job.
reminder: Clear up one of them today.

motto: I am not adjusting my voice. I am adjusting the moment.
detail: It is rare that what you said was wrong; usually it was when. The same sentence five minutes later puts nobody on the defensive.
reminder: The same thing, five minutes later.

motto: I do not agree, and I am here.
detail: Objecting does not have to take you out of the room. Saying so is hard because staying asks more of you than objecting does.

motto: Only what I promised, and all of it.
detail: Everyone knows a promise from you gets kept. The cost is this: nobody watches how much you promise, so you have to.
reminder: How much did you promise today?

motto: Saying no is a promise too.
detail: Because you never say "I can't", people keep asking. That sentence is not a slight; it is the continuation of your being reliable.
reminder: Say no to one of them today.

motto: I am in the queue too.
detail: You put your own work after everyone else's, and that moment usually never arrives. Joining the queue is not selfishness; it is the queue existing at all.
reminder: Start the queue with yourself today.

motto: I carry it, and let it show.
detail: Taking the weight quietly comes naturally to you. Because nobody knows what it weighs, it does not get lighter either — saying so is information, not complaint.
reminder: Tell one person what you are carrying today.
